events.summary: * WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.  * WHERE...The lower Cape Fear River including downtown Wilmington.  * WHEN...Until 9 PM EDT this evening.  * IMPACTS...Portions of Battleship Road and USS North Carolina Road observe minor coastal flooding up to one half foot in depth. In downtown Wilmington, a block of Water Street observes minor flooding up to one quarter foot in depth.  * ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Affected areas listed are based on average tide conditions. Additional locations may experience flooding during periods of heavy rainfall, high winds, or other factors.

events.region: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary: * WHAT...Water levels as high as 1.0 to 2.0 feet above the normal highest tide line. The highest water levels in Kwigillingok and Kongiganak.  * WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta Coast.  * WHEN...Until 4 AM Friday. The advisory may be extended depending on the following tide cycle.  * IMPACTS...Nuisance flooding of low lying areas. Coastal erosion is possible.  * ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strong south winds will push water toward the coast, resulting in elevated water levels and large surf. The greatest impacts are expected around the times of high tide between 8 AM and 11 AM Thursday and 9 PM and 3 AM Friday.
